[[File:Jon Snyder Comic-Con 2001.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Jon Snyder at the Decipher booth, Comic-Con 2001]]
'''Jon Snyder''' was Decipher's VP Fan Club Operations in 2001. He staffed the Decipher booth at Comic-Con 2001 with [[Sean Smallman]], [[Kevin Reitzel]] and [[Kyle Heuer]].<ref name="torn-cc2001">[http://www.theonering.net/movie/scrapbook/large/1536 Comic-Con 2001: Decipher], TheOneRing.net scrapbook (July 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010805025951/http://www.theonering.net:80/movie/scrapbook/large/1536 Internet Archive]</ref>
